title: _caller_identity removed from args before serde deserialization
description: DeliverHandler and ReceiptHandler both call obj.remove('_caller_identity') before passing args to serde_json::from_value. This is correct: the identity field is consumed and never reaches the PeerDeliverArgs/PeerReceiptArgs struct. A contributor might suggest passing identity separately or reading it after parsing. Do not do this: if identity remained in the JSON object after parsing, serde's deny_unknown_fields would reject it, or without that flag it would silently be ignored — neither is better than explicit removal.
